topics.title: Nassau Community College Sex Program Dispute
topics.summary: A controversy arose at Nassau Community College following a challenge to the school’s sex program which involved students drawing genitalia on mirrors and one student urinating during the course. Concerns were raised about the curriculum's appropriateness, with hosts repeatedly questioning its nature and content.

topics.title: Gary Delabate’s Unconventional Bit
topics.summary: During a studio session, John attempts to share his newly written comedy bit with the hosts, featuring nonsensical phrases and references to Gary Delabate's work. The others find it unfunny and struggle to understand its purpose, leading to frustration as they attempt to analyze and critique John’s unusual approach.

topics.title: Vinny’s Boatboard Blunder
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern discusses an absurd encounter with Vinny Mazzio Jr., who claims he was handcuffed on a boat while being harassed by men. The conversation quickly devolves into a bizarre recounting of marijuana use, gun threats, and karate skills, punctuated by repeated attempts to define ‘monopolize’.

topics.title: Boat Incident & Marijuana Claims
topics.summary: During a Joe Franklin taping, Vinnie Mazzio recounts an unsettling encounter involving accusations of marijuana use and unwanted physical attention while handcuffed on a boat. He describes being falsely accused of smoking pot alongside others, experiencing attempted kisses, and ultimately having the charges dropped.

topics.title: Vinny's Addiction & Fox TV Troubles
topics.summary: During a lengthy discussion, Howard Stern discusses his friend Vinny Mazzio Jr.'s marijuana addiction and invites him onto the show. The conversation quickly devolves into critiques of individuals – including Morton Downey Jr., Sammy Davis Jr., and Cardinal O’Malley – with accusations of stupidity and poor judgment. Later, they discuss Stern's inability to secure a television deal due to negative press from Fox News.

topics.title: Radio Station Drops Spanish, Discusses Food Prep
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts abruptly announce the discontinuation of their Spanish programming and express disgust over an intern’s food preparation habits. They discuss concerns about hygiene, particularly regarding washing apples in bathroom sinks and handling potatoes with dirty hands, leading to humorous complaints and speculation.”} 29 words
